statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I48.0 (atrial fibrillation) was submitted
The diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) was submitted
Mobile cardiac telemetry CPT 93229 was ordered
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to correlate events with symptomatic episodes of giddiness
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
